author: felicepantaleo
body:
The HLT `Target` in `RecoTICL/Configuration/python/target.py` sets `supercluster_dnn_label="hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNN"`. The Phase-2 HLT menu (`HLT_75e33`) has no module with this label. It has `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNUnseeded` and `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNL1Seeded`. A configuration built for the HLT target with superclustering therefore names its supercluster module, its validation label and its keep statement differently from the menu.

This PR sets the label to `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNUnseeded`, and adds a check to `test_validation.py` (`testPyTICLValidation`): the HLT supercluster label must be a module of `HLT_75e33`.

The second commit makes `testPyTICLValidation` compare the TICL dumper byte-for-byte with `Validation/TICLValidation/python/ticlDumper_cff.py`, like the other derived modules. The test checked only the dumper structure, because its docstring said that the cff failed on import. The cff imports without error in this release, with and without `ticl_barrel`.

testPyTICLValidation compares the type, `linkingPSet` and InputTags of the supercluster module of the HLT target with the module of the HLT_75e33 menu, and checks that the HLT validation labels contain it. The second check needs #52321, which puts `hltTiclTracksterLinksSuperclusteringDNNUnseeded` in `hltTiclIterLabelsPSet`.

#### PR validation:

- `testPyTICLValidation`: the new label check fails with the old label and passes with the new one. The derived dumper is equal byte-for-byte to `ticlDumper_cff`.
- `test_reproduce_hlt.py`, `test_event_content.py`, `test_reproduce_v5.py`, `test_plumbing.py` and `test_export_cff.py` pass.
- In the release, only the RecoTICL tests use the HLT target. No job configuration imports it, so no workflow output changes.
title: pyTICL HLT target uses the supercluster label of the HLT menu
